szenen.vo: [intense] Nobody is coming to save you.
No message. No perfect chance. Nobody knocking on your door.
[intense] But here's the thing... that door was never locked.
Everyone else is busy fighting their own battles.
[intense] There is only one person who can change your life.
[shouting] And you see that person every morning in the mirror!
[whispers] Scary? [intense] Good. That means it matters.
Nobody will build it for you. So build it. Brick by brick.
[shouting] Be the one who saves you!
